passages.text: This is the intended interaction with the Weyl BV--BFV programme. The classical complex is authoritative, but its import into quantum work must be checked object by object. Local counterterm and anomaly classification must precede coefficient calculations; restoration of the local quantum master equation must precede residual transfer. No reduced-mode or Euclidean result may be used as evidence for a Lorentzian causal claim. The reverse- foundational atlas makes these dependency cuts visible before a calculation is promoted.

passages.text: The distinction is causal, not terminological. On an exact three-site test, a nonzero projector onto a constant or harmonic mode sends a compactly supported input to a nonzero global mode and hence expands support. Such a projector cannot be used as a support-nonincreasing map in the causal Green-transfer premise. This leaves the exact local graph SDR intact and preserves both reduced-mode packages within their declared scope; it neither identifies them with the endpoint complex nor rules out a new infinite-dimensional local curvature or equation-level carrier.
